tagline: DeepSeek V4 Pro (0813) was retired on October 30, 2026.
what_it_does: DeepSeek V4 Pro (0813) was retired on October 30, 2026. DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (1017) is the recommended replacement. This page describes the model maintenance policy for the Foundation Model APIs pay per token, Foundation Model APIs provisioned throughput, Batch Inference with ai query, and Foundation Model Fine tuning offerings.
why_it_matters: Reduces operational overhead and unlocks new capabilities for data teams on Databricks.
